title: Hyundai Ioniq V Çin'de satışa çıktı
summary: Hyundai'nin yeni elektrikli sedan modeli Ioniq V, Çin pazarında satışa sunuldu ve küresel pazarlara da gelecek.
body:
CarNewsChina'nın aktardığına göre, elektrikli sedan sınıfındaki Hyundai Ioniq V 29 Eylül'de Çin pazarında satışa sunuldu. Hyundai China Design Center tarafından geliştirilen modelin ilerleyen dönemde küresel pazarlara da açılması bekleniyor. Araç, Çin'de indirimler hariç 109.900 ile 139.900 yuan (yaklaşık 16.380 – 20.850 dolar) fiyat aralığıyla alıcı buluyor.

source_texts.title: Hyundai Ioniq V launched at 16,380 USD in China ahead of global rollout
source_texts.summary: The Hyundai Ioniq V electric sedan was launched in China at 16,380 USD before discounts. This model will go global. The post Hyundai Ioniq V launched at 16,380 USD in China ahead of global rollout appeared first on CarNewsChina.com .
source_texts.text:
The Hyundai Ioniq V electric sedan was launched in China at 109,900 yuan (16,380 USD) before discounts. Despite being developed by the Hyundai China Design Center, this futuristic EV is expected to reach global markets and solidify the Korean automaker’s position in the growing NEV segment.
The Hyundai Ioniq V became available for purchase in China on September 29 with a price range of 109,900 – 139,900 yuan (16,380 – 20,850 USD) before discounts. The limited-time promotional price lies between 99,900 and 131,900 yuan (14,890 – 19,655 USD). We listed the trims and prices (before discounts) of the Hyundai Ioniq V below.
- Ioniq V 540 Pro – 109,900 yuan (16,380 USD)
- Ioniq V 540 Max – 119,900 yuan (17,870 USD)
- Ioniq V 540 Max+ – 129,900 yuan (19,360 USD)
- Ioniq V 650 Max – 129,900 yuan (19,360 USD)
- Ioniq V 650 Max+ – 139,900 yuan (20,850 USD)
The Hyundai Ioniq V adopts a new design language with sleek pillars and a bonnet line. This EV is available in eight color options: golden, purple, green, gray, white, matte white, silver, and black. The car boasts a drag coefficient of 0.23 Cd. Its dimensions are 4900/1890/1470 mm with a wheelbase of 2,900 mm. For clarity, it is 10 mm shorter than the Hyundai Sonata.
The car’s cabin boasts a large 27-inch dual-screen setup and a head-up display. The gear shifter sits behind an oval-shaped steering wheel. Its center tunnel adopts a wireless phone charging pad, a 15-liter storage compartment, and a pair of cup holders. The infotainment system is powered by the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8295 chip. Another highlight of the Ioniq V is the Momenta assisted driving system, capable of the Navigate On Autopilot (NOA) function on highways. The trunk capacity is 465 liters.
The Ioniq V stands on the 800V high-voltage system. Its entry-level variant has a 53.5 kWh LFP pack from CATL that powers a 140 kW (188 hp) electric motor. The range is 540 km under CLTC conditions (443 km WLTP). There is also a long-range variant with a 66.8 kWh LFP battery manufactured by CATL. It is paired with a 168 kW (225 hp) electric motor. The car’s range reaches 650 km CLTC (533 km WLTP).
